entries.text: A gutsy, tippling pirate with a ready laugh and only seemingly no thought of tomorrow.

entries.text: A jungle island on which things move in the corner of the eye.

entries.text: A monstrous thing, it's wings bat-like; but it's body like nothing of sea or earth or air -- foulness beyond a madman's wildest dreams.

entries.text: A pirate ship captained by a fearless rogue.

entries.text: An ill-fated merchant ship on which a pirate vessel is closing.

entries.text: Waters where the seaports are fat with loot and merchant ships crammed for plundering.

entries.text: A lord of the sea-rovers, striding the deck of his ram-prowed war galley as it bears down upon it's prey.
entries.raw_text: 1,A lord of the sea-rovers, striding the deck of his ram-prowed war galley as it bears down upon it's prey.

entries.text: The drum-beater of a massive slave galley, who picks the slowest rower each voyage to torture in front of the others.
entries.raw_text: 1,The drum-beater of a massive slave galley, who picks the slowest rower each voyage to torture in front of the others.

entries.text: A siren-mermaid, fair and lithe from afar, but with a heart as dark and cold as the deep abyss.
entries.raw_text: 1,A siren-mermaid, fair and lithe from afar, but with a heart as dark and cold as the deep abyss.

entries.text: A clifftop temple surrounded by a treacherous reef, from which alluring musics come.
entries.raw_text: 1,A clifftop temple surrounded by a treacherous reef, from which alluring musics come.

entries.text: A man marooned on a deserted island, finishing the raft that will take him to salvation or to death.
entries.raw_text: 1,A man marooned on a deserted island, finishing the raft that will take him to salvation or to death.

entries.text: A king of the underwater folk, angry that his people are dying in fishermens' nets, preparing for war.
entries.raw_text: 1,A king of the underwater folk, angry that his people are dying in fishermens' nets, preparing for war.

entries.text: A legendary warrior, now retired to the life of a fisherman, hoping to forget the horrors of his youth.
entries.raw_text: 1,A legendary warrior, now retired to the life of a fisherman, hoping to forget the horrors of his youth.

entries.text: The spirits of the drowned, sailing their ghost ship in a fog that never lifts.
